name: idempiere-migrate-agent
description: Install-side iDempiere (Postgres) → BIM-OOTB ERP migration agent. Runs natively on the machine that has the iDempiere Docker Postgres; emits ad_masters.db for the browser to load. The browser never connects to Postgres (delegate-to-install).
author: Redhuan D. Oon <red1org@gmail.com>
